problem_statement:
fix(sandbox): probe must actually run a container, not just query info

CI was failing 4 live-container tests with 'crun: unknown version
specified' instead of skipping them. Root cause: runtime_available() ran
'podman info' (which returns 0 even when the OCI runtime is broken) but
never tried to run a container, so the test skip-guard passed a false
positive and the tests errored at run time.

Now the probe runs a throwaway container from the configured image to
catch a broken OCI runtime -- but only when that image is already local
(avoids blocking on a slow pull; falls back to the info check otherwise).
Result cached for 60s so production sandbox-mode use doesn't pay the
probe cost per command. Added regression tests for the broken-runtime and
image-absent fallback paths.
